limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The theorem is restricted to finite direct sums of infinite type-I factors and self-adjoint compact implementers. The complete texts of Fialkow (1979) and Fialkow--Loebl (1984) were not inspected; their relevance was assessed through the 2026 primary source and accessible bibliographic material. No independent validation is asserted.
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
record_title: A center-local norm formula for generalized derivations on finite sums of type-I factors
